user_question: Create a choropleth map of hospital counts across Centre County.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts. Active commitments: analytical_spatial_unit=census tracts

workflow_plan.goal: Create a choropleth map of hospital counts across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Constrain hospitals to Centre County coverage
workflow_steps.purpose: Restrict the hospital point layer to the Centre County coverage represented by the supplied county subdivisions.
workflow_steps.instructions: Clip input_1 using input_3 as the spatial mask. Preserve hospital point attributes and output a GeoPackage vector layer.

workflow_steps.title: Count hospitals by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute the hospital count for each supplied Centre County census tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Count hospital points from hospitals_in_centre_county within the polygons in input_2. Leave the output count field name unset so runtime schema grounding can identify the generated hospital-count attribute.

workflow_steps.title: Create hospital-count choropleth
workflow_steps.purpose: Render an interactive choropleth map of hospital counts by census tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Generate an HTML choropleth from census_tracts_with_hospital_counts. Leave the field parameter unset so runtime schema grounding can select the generated hospital-count field.

requirements.scope: The hospital points and county-subdivision mask used by clip_hospitals_to_centre_county must have compatible CRSs.
The point and polygon geometries used by clip_hospitals_to_centre_county must be valid.
The county-subdivision mask input_3 must provide complete Centre County coverage, and the hospital candidates retained by clip_hospitals_to_centre_county must be within that coverage.
Both clip inputs must be supplied in a worker-supported vector format.
The clipped hospital points and census tract polygons used by count_hospitals_by_census_tract must have compatible CRSs.
The clipped hospital points and census tract polygons used for point counting must have valid geometries.
The point-count inputs must be GeoPackage vector datasets.
The mapped census-tract count layer must be supplied in a format supported by thematic_mapping.
The mapped layer must contain the field generated by point_count_by_polygon representing hospital counts.

commitments.rationale: The goal requests an areal choropleth without specifying the spatial unit; the supplied census tract layer provides a direct, standard polygon unit for hospital-count aggregation.
commitments.evidence_source: User goal and supplied input_2 census tract artifact
